summary: The refine-phase analysis is thorough, well-structured, and provides a strong foundation for the v2 checkpoint implementation. It correctly identifies the two core gaps in v1 (post-push context loss and no-push session blindness), accurately maps the existing architecture with specific file/line references, explores meaningful alternative approaches with clear trade-offs, and arrives at well-justified recommendations. The analysis directly led to a detailed 8-phase implementation plan with 40 acceptance criteria, confirming its utility as a planning artifact.
